name: Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity / Membership and Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity
proof: Any learner using only proper equivalence queries is a valid learner in the model that additionally permits membership queries.  The larger set of permitted queries cannot increase optimal complexity.
witness_verification: For $\mathrm{ADDRESSING}_n$, proper equivalence-query complexity is $n$, whereas the membership-plus-proper-equivalence complexity is $\Theta(\log n)$: query the bit coordinates to recover the injective address code.  Hence the gap is unbounded.
